source_caption:
Dumb and Dumber (1994) is a road buddy comedy directed by Peter Farrelly, who co-wrote the screenplay with his brother Bobby and Bennett Yellin. Starring Jim
Carrey and Jeff Daniels, the film follows two well-meaning but clueless friends who travel across the country to return a briefcase full of money, unaware it was actually left behind as ransom.
Interestingly, Jeff Daniels was not the studio’s first choice for the role, but Jim Carrey personally pushed for him to be cast. To discourage him, the filmmakers offered Daniels a much lower salary of $50,000, expecting him to turn it down, but he accepted immediately despite warnings from his agent that the film could harm his career. Instead, it went on to become his most successful film at the time.

source_details.title: Dumb and Dumber
source_details.synopsis: Dumb and Dumber is a 1994 American road buddy comedy film directed by Peter Farrelly, who cowrote the screenplay with his brother Bobby and Bennett Yellin. It is the first installment in the Dumb and Dumber franchise. Starring Jim Carrey and Jeff Daniels, it tells the story of Lloyd Christmas (Carrey) and Harry Dunne (Daniels), two dumb but well-meaning friends from Providence, Rhode Island, who set out on a cross-country road trip to Aspen, Colorado, to return a briefcase full of money to its owner, unaware it was left as a ransom.
